bibliographic.title: The Idle Demon
bibliographic.author: Charles M Ball
bibliographic.description:
You wake up on the couch in your garage after a wild Halloween party. But you can't remember why you didn't go to sleep with your wife, in your own bed. In fact, you can't remember anything after a certain point last night. But either way, it's time to go to work -- even if you can't seem to shake the voice inside your head...

The Idle Demon is a parser-based, interactive fiction horror game written in under 4 hours, with three possible endings.

Content warning: themes of torture, blood, death, domestic violence, and kidnapping.
